title: ALN Game Pack Theme (theme.json)
description: The pack's visual identity file, MINIMAL version (Phase 3 theme unit; design: docs/plans/2026-09-03-phase3-theme-unit.md in ALN-Ecosystem — Q-3c-1 ruling: semantic mode colors, rating glyph/display choice, scoreboard accent; full theming depth waits for the first real second game). game.json's `theme` field names this sidecar file (const 'theme.json'); the manifest builder assigns it the `theme` role; a pack declaring it must list `theme.identity` in `requires`. Every color is STRICT 6-digit hex — hex-only IS the injection-safety rule for the CSS custom-property sinks these values reach (no functions, no var(), no url()). The shape is CLOSED (additionalProperties false): future sections (fonts, ...) arrive by schema evolution plus engine consumption, never by loosening. Every section is optional — a theme may declare only what diverges from the engine's baked identity (ALN declares only the ruled rating star-drop).

schemaVersion.description: Exact-match on BOTH sides: the backend gate refuses any other value; the scanner mirror DECLINEs — including when ABSENT (unlike the strings sidecar's legacy tolerance, this artifact is new and headerless files refuse/decline everywhere).

colors.description: Semantic engine color tokens the theme may re-point. Keys mirror the CONSUMING token names (the engine maps them onto its CSS custom properties): modeScoring/modeEvidence drive the 3c semantic mode classes; accentPrimary the primary action accent; accentValue the mode-decoupled money-value accent. Minimal-era authoring constraint: choose mode colors that read coherently beside the engine's baked status palette (greens/ambers/reds stay baked until theme depth widens the palette).

rating.description: How the GM scanner's three rating display sites render a token's value rating (Q-3b-2: star DISPLAYS are informational-only; the rating stays the bury-value input regardless). 'stars' = glyph repeat (today's form); 'numeric' = the plain digit; 'none' = the rating element is not rendered at all (ALN's ruled choice). Config-tool previews and the session report's contracted star cell are OUT of this choice (program §13.5).

glyph.description: The star glyphs used when display is 'stars'. Each is a 1-4 code-point plain TEXT GLYPH (the modes[].icon idiom: no markup characters, rendered as content and ESCAPED at every interpolation regardless; value twins on both engine sides strip control/bidi then re-check). 'empty' pads unearned positions at the padded site; omitting it keeps filled-only rendering there. DEL and bidi controls PASS this pattern but are stripped-then-checked by the VALUE twins (activation gate + scanner DECLINE), which are the runtime authority — the pattern is deliberately no stricter than the values the twins can accept (the verbNoun precedent).

scoreboard.description: The scoreboard page's brand accent pair (the page's --evidence-red / --evidence-red-dark tokens), injected server-side via %%PACK_THEME%% and re-validated at the sink.
